question: Oda-sensei and the characters of One Piece say "Spirit" a lot, but what exactly is Spirit?! I don't get it. I looked it up in the dictionary and... it wasn't even in there! Do other readers get it? Please tell me!
answer: "Spirit" is "to feel strongly". When someone hopes for something really hard, it happens. Those people are glamorous. No questions, just a little game made by a reader.
